verses.text: Jabin, king of Hazor, heard about it and called in backup: Jobab king of Madon, the king of Shimron, and the king of Achshaph. 🗣️
He also reached out to the northern kings—from the hill country, the Arabah south of Chinneroth, the lowlands, and Dor’s western highlands—🗺️
plus the Canaanites east and west, the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites in the hills, and Hivites below Mount Hermon in Mizpah. 📣
They rolled out with all their armies—a huge crowd, as many as sand along the seashore, with horses and chariots everywhere. 🐎
All those kings joined up and camped together by the waters of Merom, ready to fight Israel. ⚔️
Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Don’t be afraid of them. By this time tomorrow, I’ll hand them all over to Israel, dead. Hamstring their horses and burn their chariots.’ 🛡️
So Joshua and all the warriors made a surprise move against them by the waters of Merom. ⚔️
Yahweh handed them over to Israel. Israel struck them and chased them to Great Sidon, Misrephoth Maim, and the Valley of Mizpah eastward. They kept striking until nobody was left. ⚔️
Joshua did exactly what Yahweh told him: he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots. 🔥
Then Joshua turned back, took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword. Hazor used to lead all those kingdoms. 🏰
They struck down everyone there with the sword and completely destroyed them. Nobody was left breathing. Joshua burned Hazor. 🔥
Joshua captured all the cities of those kings and their kings, then struck and completely destroyed them, just as Moses, Yahweh’s servant, had commanded. ⚔️
Israel didn’t burn the cities standing on their mounds—except Hazor. Joshua burned that one. 🏙️
Israel kept the plunder from those cities and the livestock. But every person they struck with the sword was destroyed; they didn’t leave anyone breathing. 🐑
Yahweh had commanded Moses, Moses had commanded Joshua, and Joshua carried it out. He left nothing undone of everything Yahweh had commanded Moses. 📜
Joshua took all that land: the hill country, the whole South, Goshen, the lowlands, the Arabah, Israel’s hill country, and its lowlands, 🗺️
from Mount Halak, on the way up to Seir, all the way to Baal-gad in Lebanon Valley below Mount Hermon. He took all their kings and struck them down. 🏔️
Joshua was at war with all those kings for a long time. 🕰️
Not one city made peace with Israel except the Hivites living in Gibeon. Israel took every other place in battle. 🛡️
Yahweh had hardened their hearts so they would come out to fight Israel. That way they’d receive no mercy and be destroyed, just as Yahweh had commanded Moses. ⚖️
Around then Joshua wiped out the Anakim from the hill country—Hebron, Debir, Anab, and all Judah’s and Israel’s hill country. He completely destroyed them and their cities. ⚔️
No Anakim were left in Israel’s land. Some remained only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod. 🗺️
So Joshua took the whole land, just as Yahweh had told Moses, and gave it to Israel as an inheritance, tribe by tribe. Then the land had a break from war. 🕊️
